pathways.title: MFJ competition licence pathway
steps: Join an MFJ-affiliated club (クラブ登録) / obtain MFJ membership as published for the season
Choose the appropriate road-race licence category (International / Domestic / Freshman / Junior — names as published by MFJ)
Complete the required in-person circuit practical course at an MFJ-approved road-race circuit (WEB講習 is not available for road race)
Complete medical / equipment requirements as published for the licence year
Apply via MFJ licence channels; licences follow the Apr 1–Mar 31 year
pathways.notes: High-level only — no invented clause numbers. Road-race applicants need an in-person circuit course at an MFJ-listed venue (Motegi, SUGO, Tsukuba, Fuji, Suzuka, Okayama, Autopolis, and others on the applicants page).
